messages:
Elaine: Ugh — fiber out on my street, thanks to the construction crew. Had to switch to phone tether + the old USB-C dock. Pizza delivery saved my sanity. pic: https://imgur.com/placeholder

mike: oh no! which carrier? neighbor Starlink? :eyes:

Elaine: T-Mobile 4G. Signal's okay if I sit on the balcony. Tried to do the standup from the kitchen counter — camera angle was tragically low.

james: tilt the laptop up on a couple of mugs, lower the eye line, looks more natural. Also turn off HD in Zoom if bandwidth is flaky.

sophia: pro tip: put a bit of paper under the webcam to raise it slightly. also mute when chewing :joy:

maria: if you need NAT stability, try USB tethering -> router. (not literally `sysctl` on your phone 😅).

Elaine: Tried USB tethering, it drops after ~20m. Here's what `ip a` shows when it's flaky:
```
3: usb0: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 qdisc fq_codel state UP group default qlen 1000
    inet 192.168.42.69/24 brd 192.168.42.255 scope global usb0
```

infra-bot: Deploy status: no incidents in the last 24h :white_check_mark:

mike: also, if Zoom is choppy try `sudo tc qdisc del dev usb0 root` then `sudo tc qdisc add dev usb0 root fq_codel` — clears bad buffering (if you're comfortable).

Elaine: thanks! trying now — pizza arrived so i'll test during lunch :pizza:

sophia: post a before/after pic of your setup please :camera_with_flash:

Elaine: posted: https://imgur.com/placeholder2 — balcony + folding chair + pizza box

jonathan: absolute chef's kiss. remote warrior setup :chef_kiss:

maria: glad you're back online. if this becomes recurring, please submit a quick infra ticket and we'll scope a backup ISP for the area.

Elaine: will do. big thanks all :heart:

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-4721 — 'User reported repeated mobile-tether fallback during fiber outage' @oncall
